reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the per-serving price ($29.99 for 30 sachets, so $1 a day) and then the 'Every batch lab-tested' line with the QR. That is nice, but it is not an NSF or USP seal, and I already have Thorne and Pure Encapsulations on Subscribe & Save. I would not switch to a brand with zero reviews, and the Complex has citrate in it, which gives me cramps.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A brand's own QR report is not the same as a third party certifying it, and I do not put an unknown brand in my body just because the box is pretty.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, plus a few hundred verified reviews, and only the Bisglycinate with no citrate. A cheaper trial size would also get me to try it once.
